name: BULK
steps: Sign up at app.bulk.trade through that link. A referred trader gets a "+5% Trading AURA boost".
Deposit USDC, the margin and settlement currency.
Trade, then check your AURA and your league on the AURA page .
Once you trade, you get your own referral link. BULK pays referrers "1 AURA for every 4 Trading AURA they earn" plus 10% of the net fees of the traders they bring in directly, paid weekly in USDC.
what: BULK's Solana perps exchange is still invite-only, now through referral links. How AURA and the Challenger Series work, fees and the reported 30% airdrop.
behind: BULK raised an $8 million seed round in September 2025, led by 6th Man Ventures and Robot Ventures, with Wintermute investing and Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko as an angel, SolanaFloor reported. costs: The launch fees still applied on 21 October: makers pay no base fee and takers pay 0.035% at the lowest volume tier, and BULK's fee settings showed no change scheduled. The docs say a new fee policy "activates atomically at its configured protocol slot", so check the Fees page before you trade. There's no separate liquidation fee, but liquidation prices include market-impact adjustments. The Fees
risks: The terms exclude many places, including the US, the UK, Australia, Ontario, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and the UAE. The 30% airdrop figure comes from press reports, not from BULK. BULK can change, withhold or cancel points at any time without notice, and the terms allow KYC checks.
